HockeyAllsvenskan Game record

Source: R/ha.R
ha_game.Rd

One game's CMS record by slug (2025/26 onward): StatNet game number and team ids, scores by period, venue, attendance.

Same columns as ha_schedule(). Game records start in 2025/26; a slug the site does not know answers fastRhockey_no_data.

Usage

ha_game(slug, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

slug

Game slug yyyymmdd-home-away (slug in ha_schedule), e.g. 20260918-aik-modo.

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE). Pass FALSE for the raw JSON as a list (stamped with the request under _request where the body does not say what it answers).

Value

A tibble (return_parsed = TRUE), else the raw JSON list:

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025/26).
game_cms_idintegerCMS (Strapi) record id of the game.
game_document_idcharacterCMS (Strapi) document id of the game.
cms_seasoncharacterCMS season key as sent (season_2026 = 2026/27: a START year).
statnet_game_numberintegerStatNet game number (23401 = 2026/27 game 1); the play-by-play request key.
slugcharacterGame slug yyyymmdd-home-away (lower-case CMS short names); the /api/game?slug= key.
roundintegerRound number of the game in the season schedule.
scheduled_date_timecharacterScheduled face-off time (ISO 8601 UTC).
venuecharacterArena name on the CMS game record.
attendanceintegerAttendance; null for an unplayed game (0 for a played one means unknown).
current_periodcharacterLive period while the game runs; empty string ” before and after.
current_period_startcharacterStart time of the live period; null outside a live game.
home_scoreintegerHome goals, final.
away_scoreintegerAway goals, final.
ended_date_timecharacterEnd time (ISO 8601 UTC).
decided_incharacterHow the game was decided (FT, OT, SO); empty for a game not yet played.
home_score_p1integerHome goals in period 1.
away_score_p1integerAway goals in period 1.
home_score_p2integerHome goals in period 2.
away_score_p2integerAway goals in period 2.
home_score_p3integerHome goals in period 3.
away_score_p3integerAway goals in period 3.
home_ot_scoreintegerHome overtime goals; null when the game had no overtime.
away_ot_scoreintegerAway overtime goals; null when the game had no overtime.
home_so_scoreintegerHome shootout goals; null when the game had no shootout.
away_so_scoreintegerAway shootout goals; null when the game had no shootout.
game_typecharacterGame type (phase): HA regular season, HAPlayoff playoffs, HAkval playout.
play_off_gamecharacterGame of the playoff series (1, 2, ...); null outside the playoffs.
play_off_game_levelcharacterPlayoff round label.
played_date_timecharacterActual start time (ISO 8601 UTC).
is_completedlogicaltrue once the game is final.
home_statnet_idcharacterStatNet team id of the home team (AIK, MODO, MIK).
away_statnet_idcharacterStatNet team id of the away team.
created_atcharacterCMS creation time of the record (ISO 8601 UTC).
updated_atcharacterCMS update time of the record (ISO 8601 UTC).
published_atcharacterCMS publish time of the record (ISO 8601 UTC).
home_team_cms_idintegerCMS (Strapi) record id of the home team (81 = AIK).
home_team_document_idcharacterHome team: CMS (Strapi) document id (string; stable across drafts and locales).
home_team_namecharacterHome team: short club name (the teams list's name).
home_team_codecharacterDisplay code of the home team (AIK, MoDo, MORA, NVIF, ÖIK), not the StatNet id.
home_team_main_color_hexcharacterHome team: primary colour (hex).
home_team_alternate_color_hexcharacterHome team: secondary colour (hex).
home_team_team_arenacharacterHome team: home arena.
home_team_arena_addresscharacterHome team: postal address of the arena (multi-line, newline-separated).
home_team_arena_latitudenumericHome team: arena latitude, decimal degrees.
home_team_arena_longitudenumericHome team: arena longitude, decimal degrees.
home_team_arena_telephonecharacterHome team: arena telephone contact.
home_team_tickets_provider_urlcharacterHome team: ticket shop URL.
home_team_club_mate_lottery_urlcharacterHome team: club lottery URL.
home_team_created_atcharacterHome team: CMS creation time of the record (ISO 8601 UTC).
home_team_updated_atcharacterHome team: CMS update time of the record (ISO 8601 UTC).
home_team_published_atcharacterHome team: CMS publish time of the record (ISO 8601 UTC).
home_team_logo_urlcharacterLogo URL of the home team.
away_team_cms_idintegerCMS (Strapi) record id of the away team.
away_team_document_idcharacterAway team: CMS (Strapi) document id (string; stable across drafts and locales).
away_team_namecharacterAway team: short club name (the teams list's name).
away_team_codecharacterDisplay code of the away team, not the StatNet id.
away_team_main_color_hexcharacterAway team: primary colour (hex).
away_team_alternate_color_hexcharacterAway team: secondary colour (hex).
away_team_team_arenacharacterAway team: home arena.
away_team_arena_addresscharacterAway team: postal address of the arena (multi-line, newline-separated).
away_team_arena_latitudenumericAway team: arena latitude, decimal degrees.
away_team_arena_longitudenumericAway team: arena longitude, decimal degrees.
away_team_arena_telephonecharacterAway team: arena telephone contact.
away_team_tickets_provider_urlcharacterAway team: ticket shop URL.
away_team_club_mate_lottery_urlcharacterAway team: club lottery URL.
away_team_created_atcharacterAway team: CMS creation time of the record (ISO 8601 UTC).
away_team_updated_atcharacterAway team: CMS update time of the record (ISO 8601 UTC).
away_team_published_atcharacterAway team: CMS publish time of the record (ISO 8601 UTC).
away_team_logo_urlcharacterLogo URL of the away team.

Errors

fastRhockey_no_data: the site has nothing for the request (a season before 2005/06, an unknown or pre-2025/26 game, a phase not played, a body without rows). fastRhockey_bad_request: a value outside its enumerated set, a field the site requires is missing, or HTTP 400/422. fastRhockey_asset_fetch: any other non-2xx, a connection failure after retries, or an empty, non-JSON, error-shaped, truncated or out-of-scope 200 (the answer is unknown, not empty).
